NORTHBRIDGE HOLDINGS GROUP — Q4 PROCUREMENT & TRAVEL ADDENDUM

1. Q4 Vendor Invoice Cutoff
All approved Q4 vendor purchase orders must be submitted to Procurement by December 11, 2026. Standard net-30 payment terms apply to approved Tier-1 suppliers.

2. Conference Lodging Exceptions
Exceptions above the $320/night lodging cap require written VP pre-approval prior to booking.
